# Global Islamic Care (GIC) — AI-Readable Site Summary

## About

Global Islamic Care (GIC) is a Bangladesh-based comprehensive education platform connecting verified, qualified Muslim teachers and tutors (both male and female) with students and parents worldwide. GIC offers two foundational tracks:
1. **Quran & Islamic Education (কোরআন ও ইসলামিক শিক্ষা):** Sahih Quran recitation, Nurani Qaida, Tajweed, Hifz (memorization), Nazera, Quran translation & Tafseer, Arabic language, Masla-Masayel (Fiqh), and Islamic ethics taught by certified Hafez, Alim, and Mufti teachers.
2. **General Academic Education (জেনারেল একাডেমিক শিক্ষা):** All school and college subjects (Bangla, Mathematics, English, General Science, Physics, Chemistry, Biology, Higher Math, ICT, Accounting) from Primary (Class 1-5), High School (Class 6-10 / SSC), to Higher Secondary (HSC / College) taught by practicing Muslim university graduates and experienced educators.

Teaching Modes Supported:
- **Online 1-on-1 Live Classes:** Interactive classes conducted via Google Meet or Zoom for students in Bangladesh and expatriates globally.
- **In-Person Home Tuition (সরাসরি বাসায় গিয়ে অফলাইন হোম টিউশন):** Verified teachers travel directly to students' homes within designated service areas (e.g., Dhaka, Chittagong, Sylhet, Gazipur, and various local areas across Bangladesh).

GIC operates on a transparent, direct-contact model: students and parents browse verified teacher profiles and connect directly via WhatsApp. There is no middleman, no student commission, and no hidden enrollment charges.

Website: https://globalislamiccare.com

## Educational Tracks & Services Offered

### 1. Quran & Islamic Education Track (কোরআন ও ইসলামিক শিক্ষা)
- **সহীহ কোরআন তেলাওয়াত শিক্ষা (Sahih Quran Recitation):** Correct recitation starting from Nurani Qaida / Norani Qaida with Tajweed rules.
- **হেফজুল কুরআন (Hifz / Quran Memorization):** Complete or partial Quran memorization with certified Hafez teachers following Sabak, Sabki, and Manzil methods.
- **নাজেরা পড়ানো (Nazera — Quran Reading Fluency):** Fluent Quran recitation with correct pronunciation.
- **কুরআন অর্থ ও তাফসীর (Quran Translation & Tafseer):** Verse-by-verse translation and exegesis by certified Alim scholars.
- **আরবি ভাষা শিক্ষা (Arabic Language):** Conversational Arabic, Quranic Arabic grammar (Nahw & Sarf).
- **মাসলা-মাসায়েল ও ফিকহ (Islamic Jurisprudence — Fiqh):** Essential Islamic lifestyle rulings, prayer, fasting, zakat, family matters by Mufti/Alim teachers.
- **দুয়া ও যিকর শিক্ষা (Duas and Daily Dhikr):** Essential masnoon supplications and daily adhkār.
- **নীতি-নৈতিকতা ও আদব (Islamic Akhlaq & Character Building):** Moral values, prophetic character (Sunnah & Seerah).

### 2. General Academic Tuition Track (জেনারেল একাডেমি ও টিউশন)
- **প্রাথমিক শিক্ষা (Primary All Subjects - Class 1 to 5):** Bangla, English, Math, Science, Religion taught with gentle care.
- **মাধ্যমিক শিক্ষা (High School - Class 6 to 10 & SSC):** General Math, Higher Math, General Science, Physics, Chemistry, Biology, English Grammar, Bangla Literature, ICT.
- **উচ্চ মাধ্যমিক (HSC & College - Class 11-12):** Science, Commerce, and Arts subjects.
- **নারী শিক্ষার্থীদের জন্য নারী শিক্ষিকা (Female Tutors for Female Students):** Dedicated verified Muslim female teachers available for female students and small children for both online and offline home tuition.

## Teaching Formats
1. **Online Live 1-on-1 Classes:** Anywhere worldwide via Google Meet / Zoom.
2. **Offline Home Tuition (বাসায় গিয়ে সরাসরি হোম টিউশন):** Physical home tutoring within teacher-specified coverage areas across Bangladesh.

## Target Audience
- Bangladeshi families in Bangladesh seeking trustworthy, moral Muslim home tutors or online teachers.
- Expatriate Muslim families in UK, USA, Canada, Saudi Arabia, UAE, Qatar, Malaysia, Australia wanting genuine Islamic and academic guidance.
- Parents seeking vetted Muslim male and female teachers with verified NID and educational credentials.
- Students of all ages — from young kids starting Qaida to adults seeking Tafseer or academic tutoring.

## Teacher Profiles & Verification
Every teacher on GIC:
- Submits verified National ID (NID) and educational certificates.
- Undergoes thorough manual verification before profile publication.
- Lists educational track (Islamic / Academic / Both), teaching modes (Online / Home Tuition / Both), offline coverage areas, subjects taught, and monthly fee structure.
- Communicates directly with parents/students via WhatsApp with zero intermediary fees.

## Digital Islamic Library
Free online reading and HD PDF downloads at: https://globalislamiccare.com/library.html
- Emdadia Hafezi Quran (15-line Quran with 114 Surah and 30 Para jumpers)
- Nadiatul Ampara (নাদিয়াতুল কায়দা আমপারা)
- Nurani Podhotite Quran Shikkha (নূরানী পদ্ধতিতে কুরআন শিক্ষা)
- Norani Qaida English Edition
- Tilawat Qaida (তেলাওয়াত কায়দা)
